classification.difficultyReason: Read integer coordinates of seven points in all four quadrants.

content.prompt: Write down the coordinates of each of the points marked on the Cartesian plane below.

spec.description: Unit Cartesian grid from -5 to 5, numerical labels -4 through 4 and origin 0, positive-direction arrowheads and seven supplied red points. Tick-label white masks keep the labels readable. This coordinate graph is outside the supported diagram-template families.
spec.answerVisibility: Points, letter labels, axes and grid remain visible; coordinate answers are hidden.

answer.worked: Move 4 units right and 3 units down: $C=(4,-3)$.
Move 3 units left and 2 units down: $D=(-3,-2)$.
Move 2 units left and 4 units down: $E=(-2,-4)$.
Move 2 units right and 2 units down: $F=(2,-2)$.
Move 2 units left and 2 units up: $G=(-2,2)$.
